dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: How cold will it be in Chiang Mai next week?
dialogue.reading: ˈhaʊ ˈkoʊld wɪl ɪt bi ɪn ˈtʃjɑːŋ ˈmaɪ ˈnɛkst ˈwiːk?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: It will probably be cool, and it will be cold at night.
dialogue.reading: ɪt wɪl ˈprɑːbəbli bi ˈkuːl, ənd ɪt wɪl bi ˈkoʊld ət ˈnaɪt.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Will it be freezing on the mountain?
dialogue.reading: wɪl ɪt bi ˈfriːzɪŋ ɑːn ðə ˈmaʊntən?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Maybe in the early morning. You'll definitely be cold up there.
dialogue.reading: ˈmeɪbi ɪn ði ˈɜːrli ˈmɔːrnɪŋ. juːl ˈdɛfənətli bi ˈkoʊld ˈʌp ˈðɛr.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: That's OK. I don't like the heat in Bangkok!
dialogue.reading: ðæts oʊˈkeɪ. aɪ ˈdoʊnt ˈlaɪk ðə ˈhiːt ɪn ˈbæŋkɑːk!

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Me neither. In April, the heat is terrible.
dialogue.reading: ˈmiː ˈniːðər. ɪn ˈeɪprəl, ðə ˈhiːt ɪz ˈtɛrəbəl.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: In Canada, it will definitely snow this week.
dialogue.reading: ɪn ˈkænədə, ɪt wɪl ˈdɛfənətli ˈsnoʊ ðɪs ˈwiːk.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Then I'll probably visit Canada in summer!
dialogue.reading: ˈðɛn aɪl ˈprɑːbəbli ˈvɪzɪt ˈkænədə ɪn ˈsʌmər!
